name: Photo frame
author: WinDock
description: A picture in a frame: one image file, or a folder of pictures as a slideshow (in name or date order, or shuffled, with a fade or slide between them). Choose the frame's size and shape, how a picture fills it, its border and its shadow. A click shows the next picture or opens it.

settings.label: Show
settings.description: One image file, or every picture of a folder as a slideshow. Default: one image.

settings.label: Picture
settings.description: The image file to show: PNG, JPEG, WebP, BMP, GIF, TIFF (and HEIC where Windows can open it). Photos are turned the way the camera held them.

settings.label: Folder
settings.description: The folder whose pictures are shown one after another (its own files, not sub-folders; up to 1000). The list is read again at the end of each round.

settings.label: Order
settings.description: The order of the pictures: by name as Explorer sorts them (so 2 comes before 10), by the date they were last changed, or shuffled (every picture once per round, then reshuffled). Default: by name, A to Z.

choices.label: By name, A to Z (1 to 9)
By name, Z to A (9 to 1)

settings.label: Time per picture
settings.description: How long each picture stays before the next one. Default: 10 seconds.

settings.label: Transition
settings.description: How the next picture comes in: at once, fading in over the old one, or sliding in from a side while the old one slides out. Off with Reduce motion. Default: fade.

settings.label: Transition time
settings.description: How long the fade or slide takes. Default: 600 ms.

settings.label: Pause while the pointer is over it
settings.description: The slideshow waits while the pointer rests on the frame. Off by default.

settings.label: A click
settings.description: What a click on the frame does. A middle click always opens the picture in your image viewer. Default: the next picture (a slideshow), else open the picture.

choices.label: Next picture (a slideshow), else open it

settings.label: The wheel steps through the pictures
settings.description: Turning the mouse wheel over the frame shows the next or the previous picture. On by default.

settings.label: Size on a dock
settings.description: The frame's width on a dock (its height follows the aspect ratio). On the desktop the frame fills its window instead. Default: medium.

settings.label: Width
settings.description: The picture's width on a dock, without the border and the shadow.

settings.label: Aspect ratio
settings.description: The frame's shape: the picture's own shape (a slideshow then changes shape with every picture), a fixed ratio, or your own width and height. On the desktop a fixed ratio is the largest frame of that shape that fits the window. Default: 4:3.

settings.label: Height
settings.description: The picture's height on a dock, without the border and the shadow. On the desktop the width : height ratio is kept.

settings.label: A picture of another shape
settings.description: Fill the frame and crop what sticks out (centred), or shrink the picture until it fits, with bands beside it. Default: fill.

settings.label: Band colour
settings.description: Behind a picture that fits inside the frame. #00000000 (transparent): nothing, the dock shows through.

settings.label: Border
settings.description: None (a borderless print; try it with a strong shadow), a thin line, a mat of the border width all round, or a Polaroid print (a wider band under the picture). Default: a mat.

settings.label: Border width
settings.description: The mat's width (a Polaroid's sides and top; its bottom is three times that). A thin line is always 1 DIP. Default: 6.

settings.label: Border colour
settings.description: The mat, Polaroid or line colour. Default: white.

settings.label: Rounded corners
settings.description: The radius of the frame's corners (0: square). Default: 3.

settings.label: Drop shadow
settings.description: A shadow under the frame: none, soft, medium or strong (wider and darker). Default: soft.

settings.label: Shadow offset
settings.description: How far the shadow falls below the frame. Default: 3.
